#summary Documentation

= Documentation =

!AmFast can encode and decode Python objects to AMF3 format.

 * TypeMap
 * EncodingAndDecoding





= Custom Object Types =

!AmFast supports user-defined object types.

{{{
from amfast import class_def

# Map a custom class with static attributes
class_def.map_class(MyCustomClass, class_def.ClassDef, 'class.alias', (tuple, of, static, attributes))

# Map a custom class with dynamic attributes
class_def.map_class(MyCustomClass, class_def.DynamicClassDef, 'class.alias', ())

# Map a custom class implementing IExternizeable
# ExternizeableClassDef must be sub-classed, and the
# methods readByteString and writeByteString must be implemented.
class_def.map_class(MyCustomClass, class_def.ExternizeableClassDef, 'class.alias')

# Map a custom class that is also mapped with SQLAlchemy
class_def.map_class(MyCustomClass, class_def.sa_class_def.SaClassDef, 'class.alias')
}}}
